name: Cleanup AWS Logs
description: Automatically cleans up downloaded AWS logs after analysis

actions.command: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path 'temp-logs') { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force 'temp-logs'; Write-Host '🧹 AWS logs cleaned up successfully!' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '⚠️ No logs directory found to clean up.' -ForegroundColor Yellow }"

actions.message: AWS logs have been cleaned up. The temp-logs directory has been removed.
